title: God Is Faithful! 💛 Ruth and Naomi | Bible Story for Kids | Sunday School
desc:
Would you leave your home just to stay with someone you love? Ruth did! 💛 In this Bible story for kids, Naomi and Ruth walk back to Bethlehem, Ruth works hard in Boaz's field, and God takes care of them. Then we meet Maya, a new girl at school, who learns that God is faithful today too!

📖 Memory verse: "For wherever you go, I will go." (Ruth 1:16)
🎯 Lesson: God is faithful. Be loyal to your friends, and pray when you feel alone or scared.
🙏 Great for Sunday School, Kindergarten and family devotion time.

⏱️ Chapters

0:05 Would you leave home?
0:15 A famine in Bethlehem
0:27 Sad things in Moab

0:53 Ruth stays with Naomi
1:05 Walking to Bethlehem
1:15 Ruth works hard
1:23 Kind Boaz
1:35 A basket of grain
1:44 Baby Obed
1:55 God is faithful
2:06 Maya is new at school
2:20 Pray when you feel scared
2:30 Let's pray
